newsitem.title: USA: Citizens Financial six-month net rose.
newsitem.headline: Citizens Financial six-month net rose.

text.p: Citizens Financial Group Inc said Wednesday it recorded net income of $97.1 million for the six-month period ending March 31, 1997, compared with $77.8 million for the same period last year.
The company said the increase in net income resulted from core earnings improvement related to loan and deposit growth and the completion of recent acquisitions.
Citizens said 1997 results reflect a $45 million gain on the sale of mortgage servicing, while results for the previous period include $52 million of investment gains and loan loss recapture.
Citizens Financial is 76.5 percent owned by The Royal Bank of Scotland PLC and 23.5 percent owned by the Bank of Ireland, it said.
